HIGREEN.NS.d: Hi-Green Carbon Ltd. operates in the field of waste tire reprocessing. Its primary function involves transforming discarded tires into usable products, specifically generating hydrocarbon fuel, reclaimed carbon black, and metal scrap. The company was established on August 29, 2011, by its founders Amitkumar Hasmukhrai Bhalodi, Dakshaben Shaileshbhai Makadia, Binaben Sandip Makadia, and Rajendra Umedlal Mehta, and its main office is situated in Rajkot, India.

HINDOILEXP.NS.d: Hindustan Oil Exploration Company Limited engages in the exploration, development, and production of onshore and offshore crude oil and natural gas in India. It holds interests in various oil and gas blocks/fields. The company's oil and gas assets portfolio consist of operated and non-operated acreages in Assam, Cauvery, and Cambay basins. As of March 31, 2020, its estimated proved and probable reserves on working interest basis were 26.65 million barrels of oil equivalent.

HMVL.NS.d: Hindustan Media Ventures Limited engages in the printing and publication of newspapers and periodicals in India. The company's product line includes Hindustan, a daily newspaper that provides news relating to politics, business, entertainment, sports, and other general interests; and LiveHindustan.com, a Hindi news Website.

INDIAMART.NS.d: IndiaMART InterMESH Limited operates an online B2B marketplace that connects buyers with suppliers in India and internationally. Its platform serves small and medium enterprises, large enterprises, and individuals. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Noida, India.

JYOTICNC.NS.d: Jyoti CNC Automation Limited, set up in 1988, with its head office in Rajkot, India, produces and distributes metal-cutting CNC machines worldwide. Its range includes CNC turning and turn-mill centres, vertical and horizontal machining centres, 3-axis and 5-axis machines and multi-tasking machines.

KDDL-RE.NS.d: KDDL RE is engaged in manufacturing watch components and trading in watches in India. They are also involved in the retail of luxury watches. The company is based in India.

KISSHT.NS.d: OnEMI Technology Solutions Limited runs a digital lending platform in India that uses data analytics and alternative credit scoring. It offers secured loans, for instance loans against property, and personal loans of small ticket size, and operates the Kissht financial platform for credit access.

KODYTECH.NS.d: Kody Technolab Ltd. is a deep tech company that provides AI-powered robots, AI solutions, and scalable platforms for automation across diverse industries. The company's core services encompass robotics development, AI and machine learning development, computer vision development, Internet of Things (IoT) solutions, VisionOS app development, legacy solution migration, IT consulting services, and custom software development. They also offer website and mobile application development and testing services.

KPRMILL.NS.d: K.P.R. Mill Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an integrated apparel manufacturing company in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Textile, Sugar, and Others. The company offers yarn, and knitted fabrics; and readymade garments comprising casual, sports, active, sleep, and work wear for men and women, as well as kids wear, and men's innerwear products and athleisure products.

LAGNAM.NS.d: Lagnam Spintex Limited produces cotton yarns and sells them domestically and abroad, for uses such as denim, terry towels, knitting, shirting, sweaters, socks, weaving and home textiles. It also produces yarn spun on perforated tubes, and low-twist and high-RKM open-end yarns.

MPDL.NS.d: MPDL Limited is involved in real estate development and infrastructure projects. The company focuses on construction and development of residential and commercial properties. MPDL Limited is based in India.

NDGL.NS.d: Naga Dhunseri Group Limited operates as a non-banking financial company. It invests in shares and securities; and rents commercial vehicles. The company was incorporated in 1918 and is based in Kolkata, India.

OPTIFIN.NS.d: Optimus Finance Limited is an Indian financial services company, providing a range of financial products and services. The company's offerings include loans, investment products, and other financial solutions to individuals and businesses. Optimus Finance Limited is based in India.

ORIENTALTL.NS.d: Oriental Trimex Limited imports, processes, and supplies marble products in India. The company offers a range of marble, travertine, and onyx products. It is also involved in the mining and processing of granite. The company serves architects, building and construction industry, hotels, hospitals, and shopping malls, as well as commercial, retail, and residential projects. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is based in New Delhi, India.

PAEL.NS.d: PAE Limited engages in the sale and service of lead storage batteries, power backup systems, and automotive parts in India. The company's batteries include automotive, inverter, tower tubular, flat plate, VRLA, and solar tubular batteries. It markets its batteries under the Zenide, Zenide Gold, Zenide Silver, Zenide Automotive, and Zenide Motorcycle brands. The company was formerly known as Premier Auto Electric and changed its name to PAE Limited in 2003.

PAISALO.NS.d: Paisalo Digital Limited provides business loans, SME and MSME loans, and income generation loans for business/self-employment purpose in India. It offers income generation loans for purchasing seeds, fodder, cattle's, etc.; and Paisalo- Joint Liability Group loans for agriculture and allied sectors. The company was formerly known as S. E. Investments Limited and changed its name to Paisalo Digital Limited in January 2018. Paisalo Digital Limited was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Agra, India.

PONNIERODE.NS.d: Ponni Sugars (Erode) Limited manufactures sugar and its by-products in India. It operates in two segments, Sugar and Cogeneration. The company also engages in the cogeneration of power. Ponni Sugars (Erode) Limited also exports its products. The company was formerly known as SPB Sugars and Chemicals Limited and changed its name to Ponni Sugars (Erode) Limited in January 2000. Ponni Sugars (Erode) Limited was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Chennai, India.

PREMIERPOL.NS.d: Premier Polyfilm Ltd. manufactures and sells calendared PVC products in India. The company offers PVC flooring products, such as heavy duty flooring; anti-bacterial flooring; safety flooring for buses and transport; anti-skid embossed flooring; anti-static flooring; electro static dissipation flooring; heavy-duty flexible vinyl flooring for electrical substations; and PVC laminated sheets.

RAYMONDLSL.NS.d: Raymond Lifestyle Limited is an Indian maker and retailer of branded apparel, with labels such as Raymond, Park Avenue, ColorPlus, Parx and Ethnix. It also supplies textiles, including suiting fabric sold as Raymond Fine Fabrics and cotton and linen shirting, and sells suits, blazers, trousers, denim and shirts. Home furnishings like bedsheets and towels carry the Raymond Home name.

SEJALLTD.NS.d: Sejal Glass Limited produces and sells glass with added value in India and internationally, including solar control glass in pyrolytic coated, body tinted, fireban, decor, armor, tone and solid types. Founded in 1991 and based in Mumbai, it was previously called Sezal Glass Limited until March 2014.

SENCO.NS.d: Senco Gold Limited, set up in 1994, with its head office in Kolkata, manufactures and distributes jewellery and precious metal items. Its offerings are led by gold and diamond jewellery, together with silver, platinum and gemstone pieces and fashion jewellery.

SGFIN.NS.d: SG Finserve Limited is an Indian non-banking financial company offering lending to dealers, retail customers and vendors. It also finances logistics and transportation businesses and provides supply chain funding and term loans. The company began in 1994 with the name Moongipa Securities.

SKFINDUS.NS.d: SKF India (Industrial) Ltd. produces bearings and related products, including housings and accessories, power transmission systems, specialised greases and condition monitoring solutions. Its bearing types include ball, tapered roller, cylindrical roller, spherical roller and needle roller bearings.

SONAL.NS.d: Sonal Mercantile Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SONAL and traded in INR. Its country is India.

SRGHFL.NS.d: SRG Housing Finance Limited provides housing finance in India, with home loans for construction, renovation, extension, new and resale purchase, plots and builder projects, plus loans against property, balance transfers and top-up loans. Its customers are individuals on low and middle incomes, including self-employed people.

SUPREMEIND.NS.d: The Supreme Industries Limited manufactures and sells plastic products primarily in India. The company offers a range of molded plastic furniture products, including chairs, trolleys, center and dining tables, sofa, stools, etc.; material handling and storage products, such as small bins, super jumbo crates, and injection molded and roto molded pallets and garbage bins; vacuum formed crates, P.P.

TAMBOLIIN.NS.d: Tamboli Capital Limited is an Indian financial services company offering investment banking, stock broking, and wealth management services. The company caters to both retail and institutional clients, providing advisory and execution services. Tamboli Capital Limited is based in Mumbai, India.

THIRUSUGAR.NS.d: Thiru Arooran Sugars Limited, together with its subsidiary, manufactures and sells sugar and potable/industrial alcohol in India. The company also offers by-products, including bagasse, molasses, and pressmud. In addition, it provides rectified spirits (RS); extra neutral alcohol (ENA) for bottling units to produce IMFL; and ethanol.

TRANSPEK.NS.d: Transpek Industry Limited is an India-based chemical manufacturing company specializing in thionyl chloride and acid chlorides. Their products serve diverse industries, including pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, and specialty chemicals. The company is headquartered in Vadodara, Gujarat, India.
